scope: Seen seed42 raw-u32 training/bridge; one GCC12.2 Boost1.83 executable, fresh process per row
quality_rule: two-sided95 Wilson upper <= cap on independent calibration negatives only
quality_identity: same API or proven U alias, exact geometry and construction/query/calibration checksums; duplicate rounds reuse one denominator, never sum
nested_caps: For each n/round/mode/FPR/cap12-or24, admit every executed allocation with actual filter_bytes <= n*cap/8, including smaller-cap allocations
selection: retain every eligible alias; choose minimum observed median within each named group and overall; retain all tied leaders; no replacement or new geometry
pair_ratio: nearby latency / original latency, same config/n/cap/mode/round; <1 is a nearby win
alternative_ratio: candidate latency / fastest eligible rival-group latency; <1 is a candidate win
unconditional_speed: All168 named original/nearby ratios are reported even when either fails the quality cap; eligibility accompanies every ratio
loss_handling: Retain every loss, tie, ineligible point and no-comparable view; no-comparable views excluded from win denominators
causal_claim: A geometry change alters divisor and occupancy together; this study cannot isolate oddness as the cause
limits: No fresh-seed confirmation, independent-run significance, multi-thread, construction-speed, private-template API, modern-external global-winner or unrelated key-domain claim
